responseBody.text: EOD completed at 03:12, 38 minutes late, BOD unaffected. One stall at GLHANDOFF (01:08–01:46) caused by an uncommitted session from a PENINT retry — matched to a June incident at 94% and resolved in under 5 minutes with checker approval.

items.title: CKYC upload failed — checksum mismatch on sponsor response file
items.impact: Blocks the CKYC batch upload for branch 0031. 214 pending records held past today's regulatory submission window if unresolved by 13:14.

diagnosis.text: Sponsor changed the response-file layout on 27-Jul; the checksum routine still computes over the old field order, so every file since fails validation even though the underlying data is fine.

actionSteps: Re-map the checksum routine to the current field order (spec §4.2, rev 3)
Re-run validation against the held batch
Release the batch to CKYC intake
items.externalInstructions: Apply the field-order patch in the CKYC adapter config from Ops Console → CKYC → Config (outside NehishLens), then re-run validation from Ops Console → CKYC → Re-validate.

items.title: GLHANDOFF stalled — uncommitted PENINT retry session
items.impact: The overnight GLHANDOFF stage ran 60 minutes against a 22-minute expectation. GLPOST and RECON were temporarily blocked, but BOD completed inside the deadline window.

diagnosis.text: A PENINT retry left an uncommitted session holding a row lock. GLHANDOFF waited on that lock until the session was terminated and the checkpoint resumed.

actionSteps: Terminate the orphaned PENINT session
Resume GLHANDOFF from checkpoint CKPT_0031_0728_04
Verify downstream GLPOST and RECON completion

items.title: CKYC sponsor checksum mismatch — field-order remap
items.problem: CKYC sponsor response-file checksum mismatch after a sponsor changes their file layout without notice.
items.cause: Checksum routine computed over a fixed field order; sponsor file-layout changes silently break it even though the underlying data is valid.
items.fix: Re-map the checksum routine to the current field order per the sponsor spec, re-validate the held batch, release to CKYC intake.
items.verification: Batch re-validated against CKYC spec §4.2; 0 rejects on re-run.

items.title: GLHANDOFF stall — uncommitted PENINT retry session
items.problem: EOD stalls at GLHANDOFF after a PENINT retry leaves a session open without committing.
items.cause: The PENINT retry path does not roll back or commit on failure, leaving a row lock that GLHANDOFF then waits on.
items.fix: Terminate the orphaned session, resume the checkpoint, allow GLHANDOFF to complete; flagged for a retry-path fix upstream.
items.verification: GLHANDOFF completed post-termination; downstream GLPOST and RECON cleared without further intervention.

responseBody.question: What evidence supports this diagnosis?
responseBody.answer: Three sources agree. The sponsor file dated 28-Jul carries a different field order to the one the checksum routine computes over; CKYC spec §4.2 rev 3 documents the current order; and the validation log shows every file since the change failing the same check while the underlying records are intact.

responseBody.question: What could not be verified?
responseBody.answer: Three of the six sponsors have not reported for 28-Jul, and they carry 38% of the return variance. The 51% figure is therefore computed on partial data. I will not call this a genuine spike until those three report — the same pattern appeared on 14-Jul and resolved once the missing files arrived.

responseBody.question: Has this happened before?
responseBody.answer: Yes — res#1198, applied 09-Jul and reused three times since. Same signature: a sponsor changed their response-file layout without notice and the checksum kept computing over the old order. The fix took under five minutes with checker approval.

responseBody.title: GLHANDOFF stall — uncommitted PENINT retry session
responseBody.problem: EOD stalls at GLHANDOFF after a PENINT retry leaves a session open without committing.
responseBody.cause: The PENINT retry path does not roll back or commit on failure, leaving a row lock that GLHANDOFF then waits on.
responseBody.fix: Terminate the orphaned session, resume the checkpoint, allow GLHANDOFF to complete; flagged for a retry-path fix upstream.
responseBody.verification: GLHANDOFF completed post-termination; downstream GLPOST and RECON cleared without further intervention.

items.title: CKYC upload failed — checksum mismatch on sponsor response file
items.impact: Blocks the CKYC batch upload for branch 0031. 214 pending records held past today's regulatory submission window if unresolved by 13:14.

diagnosis.text: Sponsor changed the response-file layout on 27-Jul; the checksum routine still computes over the old field order, so every file since fails validation even though the underlying data is fine.

actionSteps: Re-map the checksum routine to the current field order (spec §4.2, rev 3)
Re-run validation against the held batch
Release the batch to CKYC intake
items.externalInstructions: Apply the field-order patch in the CKYC adapter config from Ops Console → CKYC → Config (outside NehishLens), then re-run validation from Ops Console → CKYC → Re-validate.

items.title: GLHANDOFF stalled — uncommitted PENINT retry session
items.impact: The overnight GLHANDOFF stage ran 60 minutes against a 22-minute expectation. GLPOST and RECON were temporarily blocked, but BOD completed inside the deadline window.

diagnosis.text: A PENINT retry left an uncommitted session holding a row lock. GLHANDOFF waited on that lock until the session was terminated and the checkpoint resumed.

actionSteps: Terminate the orphaned PENINT session
Resume GLHANDOFF from checkpoint CKPT_0031_0728_04
Verify downstream GLPOST and RECON completion
